docs.title: About this book
docs.text:
Schlegel’s edition of the first book (Bālakāṇḍa) of Vālmīki’s Rāmāyaṇa, among the first printed editions of the epic in Europe, with a Latin translation (Bonn, 1829). Listed in the catalogue of the Rare Book Society of India.

From Internet Archive · Public domain in India

Scanned from a copy in the Robarts Library, University of Toronto; hosted by the Internet Archive. Item: Ramayana id est carmen epicum de ramae rebus gestis · Vlmki, Schlegel, August Wilhelm von, 1767-1845 · 1829, 468 scanned pages. Published 1829; August Wilhelm von Schlegel died 1845; the text is ancient; public domain in India.

This book is not stored in this library: its pages are shown from the Internet Archive when they are opened, in this library's own viewer, and each chapter ends with this credit. The pages are shown as scans in this library's viewer (zoom, pan, thumbnails); the text of this book is in a script the machine reading of the scans cannot yet give.
